description: A flexible dropdown field with type-ahead. Helps users avoid scrolling through long lists of items in the dropdown (countries, states, people, etc.).

props.autoSelectFirst: When searching, will always highlight the first option and select it on blur. `exact` will only highlight and select exact matches.
props.clearOnSelect: Reset the search text when a selection is made while using the **multiple** prop.
props.closeOnInputClick: Clicking the field while the menu is open closes it.
props.filteredOrder: Order of the matching items while searching. `none` keeps the order of **items**. `prefix` puts items with a value starting with the search first, then those with a word starting with it, then the rest. Every key in **filter-keys** counts, including ones that are not displayed; within a tier, a match in an earlier key wins. Remaining ties keep their order and items never move past a divider or subheader.
props.items: Can be an array of objects or strings. By default objects should have **title** and **value** properties, and can optionally have a **props** property containing any [VListItem props](/api/v-list-item/#props). Keys to use for these can be changed with the **item-title**, **item-value**, and **item-props** props.
props.noFilter: Do not apply filtering when searching. Useful when data is being filtered server side.

slots.item: Define a custom item appearance. The root element of this slot must be a **v-list-item** with `v-bind="props"` applied. `props` includes everything required for the default select list behaviour - including title, value, click handlers, virtual scrolling, and anything else that has been added with `item-props`.
